Case: Yesenia is a 75-year-old with history of lung cancer and 4 months of progressive low-back and right leg pain. Yesenia describes the pain as a dull ache that shoots down her right leg in no particular pattern or frequency. Recently, she started experiencing intermittent numbness throughout her right leg. Overall, she believes the pain is becoming more frequent and intolerable, as it now interrupts her sleep nightly and acetaminophen and ibuprofen have not helped. On your physical examination, you find that Yesenia has diffusely diminished sensation in her leg, but her strength and reflexes are normal.
